name: Tachibana
source:
[url=/c93220]Serino[/url]'s brother.
A kind, earnest man. After his parents' death, he takes care of [url=/c93220]Serino[/url] with [url=/c93223]Sensei[/url]'s help.
Loves fish. He also possesses decent knowledge regarding plants and flowers.
Later on in the story, [spoiler]Tachibana's real identity is revealed. His true name is Hiiragi, a fox that lives in the mountain. Having witnessed the real Tachibana's final moment, he decided to fulfill the man's last wish, which is to take care of his little sister.[/spoiler]
